description: Blind gold labels for two-token spaced-CJK author names: which whitespace token is the family name. Judges saw the raw string only, never any sinonym output, so the labels score any routing rule or lexicon asset without buying a new judge round. 'family' is the consensus verdict; 'class' names the lexicon-evidence sub-class the family-first router keys on, recomputed with the rule's real gate; 'occ' is corpus author-row occurrences of that name string.

provenance.protocol: 5 single-judge shards of 92 plus a 60-item overlap judged by 3 judges with different personas; ids opaque; items shuffled across strata
provenance.agreement: 60/60 unanimous on the overlap, 100% pairwise; 20/20 attention checks
provenance.population: 2,511,133 name strings / 17,466,455 occ: every two-token Han/kana corpus name whose live normalize_name() FAILS, i.e. the non-Chinese stratum where canonical_name.normalized decides the surname. Chinese-detected rows are excluded because production takes the routed trio for them.
provenance.sampling: stratified by lexicon-evidence sub-class, occ-weighted and uniform draws per class, so class shares here do NOT match corpus shares - weight by class_population when projecting
